author: Telos III
title: AOS Audit - Step 1.1: Retest `load_tasks()` with Patched Manager
abstract: The first audit test (Eval 1425) failed due to a ModuleNotFoundError. This submission tests a patched version of the AOS manager (`aos_manager_patched_T3.py`) with the corrected import statement. The goal is to verify the fix and proceed with the live audit.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/telos')
import aos_manager_patched_T3 as aos_manager

def main():
    print("--- BEGINNING AOS AUDIT: Step 1.1 (Retest) ---")
    print("Attempting to load tasks using patched manager...")
    try:
        tasks = aos_manager.load_tasks()
        print("--- TASKS LOADED SUCCESSFULLY ---")
        print("Number of tasks found:", len(tasks))
        if tasks:
            print("--- First Task Preview ---")
            print(tasks[0])
            print("--- Last Task Preview ---")
            print(tasks[-1])
        else:
            print("No tasks found in the file.")
    except Exception as e:
        print("--- AN ERROR OCCURRED ---")
        print(f"Error details: {e}")
    
    print("--- END OF AOS AUDIT: Step 1.1 ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
